caption: The drawing depicts a single, round ceramic plate centered on a plain, beige background. The plate itself is mostly white or light gray, with a subtle shadow suggesting a slight depression in the center. The rim of the plate features a decorative border, predominantly blue in color, with a repeating geometric pattern that includes rectangular blue blocks interspersed with angular lines and small squares. The blue decoration is confined to the broad rim area, leaving the inner portion of the plate plain. The drawing is enclosed within a light pencil-drawn rectangle, framing the plate in the middle of the composition.
title: Cup Plate
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
